subject: [PATCH 4/5] iomap: pass iomap_iter_next_fn directly instead of struct iomap_ops

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the iomap code by removing the struct iomap_ops, which only contained a single function pointer. Instead, the iomap_iter_next_fn is passed directly to the iomap_iter and other entry points. This change is possible because all filesystems now implement ->iomap_next() and have removed the legacy fallback. The patch also renames the ops field in the iomap_iter tracepoint to next for consistency.
